1479-2841-7893-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7893-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-7435--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.

967-2557-3809-4247-7087.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1947-3327-4613-7388.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-3327-4613-7388.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

654-1308-2557-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

913-2440-4183-7895.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Little Bear
913-2440-4183-7895.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear with haste.
When the token Little Bear enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Little Bear trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Little Bear, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Little Bear for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-6627-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
3099-4762-6627-7803.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal and Brad Boimler.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

206-1368-1563-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
206-1368-1563-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1874-3490-4050-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-3490-4050-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

856-1477-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

2440-5663-7220--108.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Glamermite token.
When the Glamermite token enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Glamermite trigger, untapping Cayth
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a type with the Glamermite token.
Repeat.
2440-5663-7220--108.notes: You must choose a card from the template that can make a token copy of Glamermite.

3967-4200-4681.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1329-3338-3375-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

323-628-5670--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
323-628-5670--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, and its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter on it. Falkenrath Noble also triggers regardless.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat

3532-5078-6604-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-6604-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

339-677-5256-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1781-1978-4747.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
1781-1978-4747.description:
Cause Alena to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Alena.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-4694-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.
1978-4694-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

67-1676-2999-5670-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-2999-5670-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Impassioned Orator and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Impassioned Orator triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-2999-5670-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

1395-1987-4423-6893.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Eternity Elevator.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

431-851-4772-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-4772-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

225-539-907-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping PuPu UFO as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

2577-5670-6823.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-6823.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.

Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

224-1772-3147-6664.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

394-856-2511-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

The creature triggers, causing you to loot.

Resolve the Kyren Negotiations ability.
Repeat.

803-5256-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
803-5256-5853.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
803-5256-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Snail, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Snail's power.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

250-1863-3946.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability and The Gitrog Monster's first ability trigger.
Resolve The Gitrog Monster trigger, sacrificing Glacial Chasm.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, choosing not to pay and doing nothing as Glacial Chasm is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

586-2034-4790-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
586-2034-4790-5149.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Priest of Gix token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Priest of Gix tokens.

1821-3764-4659-4875.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
When the Pincher enters the battlefield as a Phyrexian due to Conspiracy, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Incubator, adding {C}{C}.

Repeat.

1266-2178-4050-4763.description:
Cast Goblin Arsonist by paying {R}.
Goblin Arsonist enters the battlefield, triggering Thornbite Staff, attaching it to Goblin Arsonist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Goblin Arsonist, adding {R}.
Goblin Arsonist dies, triggering itself, Koll, and Thornbite Staff.
Resolve Goblin Arsonist's trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve Koll's trigger, returning Goblin Arsonist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Thornbite Staff's trigger, accomplishing nothing.
Repeat.

1765-2558-3698-3983.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station and Chishiro's first ability.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, causing target player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Chishiro trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token that enters as a 1/1 due to Night of Souls' Betrayal.
The Spirit enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Spirit token.
Repeat from step 2.

292-855-1495.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-855-1495.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1089-1525-3681-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton and Curiosity attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
1089-1525-3681-4298.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
